headline: Approved 2026-2027 First and Third Class Liquor License Renewals as listed with standard conditions.
summary: The commission adopted its agenda and consent agenda unanimously. The consent agenda included approval of First and Third Class Liquor License Renewals for 2026-2027 with standard conditions. The meeting lasted about four minutes.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, which included the 2026-2027 First and Third Class Liquor License Renewals as listed with all standard conditions.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Commissioner Broderick, seconded by Commissioner Schachter, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
